title: Alchemists in the Study
description: Two hooded alchemists sit at a wooden table covered in arcane papers, maps, and lit candles. One in purple examines a smartphone while the other in orange draws with a quill, surrounded by a stone chamber filled with occult diagrams, a large cosmic beetle, and floating magical orbs.
